about_the_game:
Get ready to jump, dodge deadly traps, and face pixelated creatures in this retro 2.5D adventure!

Joe and the Lost Pixels is a playable tribute to the greatest classics of the 80s, full of nods to a golden era where every jump could be your last and every level hides dangers behind each pixel. Here, every screen is a trap waiting to be discovered.

You play as Joe, a brave (and slightly clumsy) adventurer in search of the mythical lost pixels, which hold the power to restore a world corrupted by digital oblivion. But it won’t be easy: snakes, spikes, vanishing platforms, sea creatures, secret labyrinths, and much more await you.

Don’t worry too much—sometimes you’ll be lucky enough to find a weapon or two to defend yourself... just don’t get too confident.

And of course, Joe has a classic mission: to rescue the usual princess. You know how this goes...

Features:

  •  Classic platforming with modern physics and 3D graphics in a 2.5D perspective

  •  Varied levels: jungles, temples, underwater caves, pixelated fortresses...

  •  Light puzzles and old-school skill-based challenges

  •  Full controller and keyboard support

  •  Instant death and quick restarts—just like the good old days

Do you have what it takes to save the world from forgotten pixels?

Add it to your wishlist so you don't miss the launch!
